instructions.label: L002d
instructions.string: You can't start or clear loads in RequestListener or Target callbacks. If you're trying to start a fallback request when a load fails, use RequestBuilder#error(RequestBuilder). Otherwise consider posting your into() or clear() calls to the main thread using a Handler instead.
